description.en: Security products, open-source tools, and collaboration from 55AA Security Lab.
description.zh: 55AA 安全实验室的安全产品、开源工具与合作方式。

descriptor.en: Rebuild security products for the AI era with Autoresearch
descriptor.zh: 用 Autoresearch 重构 AI 时代的安全产品

summary.en: Cyber AutoResearch turns the working methods of security experts into a shared engine for four product areas: environments, offense, defense, and vulnerability management.
summary.zh: Cyber AutoResearch 把安全专家的研究过程转化为共同 Engine，支撑环境、攻、防、漏洞治理四类安全产品。

title.zh: Cyber AutoResearch：Autoresearch 原生安全产品｜55AA

description.en: A shared Autoresearch engine for four security product areas: environment reconstruction, autonomous fuzzing, continuous agent isolation assurance, and PoC generation.
description.zh: 以共同 Autoresearch Engine 支撑环境重建、自动化 Fuzzing、持续 Agent 隔离保障与 PoC 生成四类安全产品。

ask.en: We are looking for early customers interested in exploring Cyber AutoResearch use cases with us. Please
ask.zh: 正在寻找愿意共同探索 Cyber AutoResearch 应用场景的早期客户，欢迎

descriptor.en: Test different security governance approaches in synthetic scenarios
descriptor.zh: 在合成场景中检验不同的安全治理方案

summary.en: Cyber Range tests different security governance approaches in synthetic scenarios, so teams can compare how well they control risk and what unintended effects they may cause before real-world use.
summary.zh: Cyber Range 在合成场景中检验安全治理方案，让团队在实际应用前比较各方案控制风险的效果，以及可能带来的意外影响。

title.zh: Cyber Range：可回放的网络风险实验｜55AA

description.en: An early cyber-risk simulation product for comparing governance rules, replaying causal chains, and examining tradeoffs in synthetic scenarios.
description.zh: 早期网络风险推演产品，用于比较治理规则、回放因果链，并观察合成场景中的风险与代价。

descriptor.en: Cybersecurity from fundamentals to mastery — consolidating existing knowledge, collecting security intelligence, and improving signal-to-noise, for humans and AI
descriptor.zh: 网络空间安全从入门到精通：沉淀已有知识、收集安全情报、提升信噪比，面向人与 AI 的知识库

summary.en: Cyber Handbook consolidates existing systems knowledge, security topics, research methods, and interview preparation, while continuously collecting security intelligence and improving signal-to-noise. It serves both people and AI.
summary.zh: Cyber Handbook 沉淀已有知识（系统知识、安全主题、科研方法、面试准备），持续收集安全情报并提升信噪比；既供人学习和查阅，也可作为 AI 的网络空间安全知识库。

title.zh: Cyber Handbook：学习路线、科研方法与面试｜55AA

description.en: An open system-security handbook consolidating existing knowledge, collecting security intelligence, and improving signal-to-noise.
description.zh: 开放的 Cyber Handbook：沉淀已有知识、收集安全情报、提升信噪比。
